caption: The drawing shows a tall, freestanding grandfather clock with a wooden case, primarily in shades of brown with gold accents. The upper section, or hood, features an arched top with decorative gold finials on either side and a central sculpted ornament. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals and two black hands, and is surrounded by a gold border and an intricate design at the top of the arch above the dial. The trunk, or middle section, has a long rectangular door with an oval-shaped gold design in the center and additional gold trim around its border, including a garland motif. The base of the clock is wider, with curved feet, and has an oval inlay outlined in gold. The overall composition has a vertical orientation, and the background is plain and light-colored, creating a clear contrast with the clock’s wooden and gold features.
title: Tall Clock
